name: FLA_INCREMENT_TEMPLATES_ALL_
description: FLA_INCREMENT_TEMPLATES_ALL contains the payment increase agreement templates.

columns.name: INCREMENT_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Unique payment increase agreement template identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: INCREMENT_TEMPLATE_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment increase agreement template number.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the payment increase agreement template.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the payment increase agreement template.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_NAME
columns.description: Payment increase agreement template name.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Payment increase agreement template description.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the payment increase agreement template.

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Supplier identifier.  It is used to send the information to Payables during the payment process.

columns.name: PAYMENT_PURPOSE_CODE
columns.description: Payment purpose. Values are populated from the ORA_FLA_PAYMENT_PURPOSE lookup.

columns.name: PAYMENT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Payment currency code of the payments which can be added to this payment increase agreement.

columns.name: ASSESSMENT_FREQUENCY_CODE
columns.description: Assessment frequency. Possible values are Annual or Semi-Annual.

columns.name: ASSESS_IN_YEARS_NUM
columns.description: Defines the breaks for the assessment. This is applicable if the assessment frequency is Annual.

columns.name: BASIS_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Basis type defines how the basis amount is arrived at. Possible values are Previous Cycle or Current Cycle.

columns.name: BASIS_COMPOUNDING_CODE
columns.description: Defines if compounding of payment basis amount is applicable.

columns.name: INCREASE_AMOUNT_ROUNDING_CODE
columns.description: Rounding code indicates how to round off the increase amount.

columns.name: INCREASE_CALC_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Defines whether to use index based, fixed rate based, or a greater or lower value of both when calculating the increase percent.

columns.name: FIXED_INCREASE_PERCENT
columns.description: Fixed increase percent which will be applicable as default when the assessment periods are generated.

columns.name: FIXED_INCREASE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Fixed increase amount which will be applicable as default when the assessment periods are generated.

columns.name: BASIS_FACTOR_PERCENT
columns.description: Basis factor percent which will be applicable as default when the assessment periods are generated.

columns.name: RESPONSIBLE_USER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the user responsible for the lease agreement template creation.

columns.name: INCREMENT_INDEX_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Payment increase index identifier referenced from FLA_INCREMENT_INDEX_HDRS_ALL.

columns.name: INDEX_FINDER_MONTHS
columns.description: Indicates the check for index can span for these number of months.

columns.name: MINIMUM_INCREASE_PERCENT
columns.description: Minimum increase percent as input by the user.

columns.name: MAXIMUM_INCREASE_PERCENT
columns.description: Maximum increase percent as input by the user.

columns.name: UNUSED_INCREASE_TREATMENT_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the way the unused increase should be treated.

columns.name: ACTIVATION_DERIVATION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the way the missing index should be derived during activation of payment increase agreement.

columns.name: ASSESSMENT_DERIVATION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the way the missing index should be derived during assessment of an assessment period.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of payment increase agreement template, valid values are PAYMENT and BILLING.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Bill-to customer identifier for the billing.

columns.name: BILL_TO_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Bill-to customer site use identifier.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Ship-to customer site use identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Transaction type identifier to be sent to Receivables.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
